description: Scaffold a new native Apple app (iOS/iPadOS/macOS/watchOS/visionOS, Swift 6) at the repository root — a generator manifest (XcodeGen's `project.yml`, or Tuist's `Project.swift` + `Tuist.swift`) declaring one application target `<AppName>-<Platform>` (scheme of the same name) per selected platform with `MARKETING_VERSION`/ `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION`, `SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY = complete`, Info.plist keys and a pinned test host; a shared UI-framework-free `Packages/Core` local SwiftPM package (Foundation + Observation only: `Models/`, `Services/`, plus `ViewModels/` for `architecture: mvvm` or `Controllers/` + a passive-view protocol for `architecture: mvc`) whose Swift Testing suite covers 100% of its lines; per-platform `Targets/<Platform>/{Sources,Tests,UITests}` — SwiftUI `App` + MVVM screen, or for the iOS/iPadOS target with `ui: uikit` a programmatic UIKit app (`AppDelegate` + `UIWindowSceneDelegate` with a scene manifest, `UINavigationController` root, `UIViewController` laid out in code, `mvc` controller core or `mvvm` with UIKit Observation tracking, `UIObservationTrackingEnabled` below iOS 26); a `--uitesting` launch argument and accessibility identifiers on every control; a Swift Testing unit-test target and an XCUITest UI-test target per platform — per the catalog's UI contract, a `.ui-quality.yml` at the root, the shared `Tests/Support/UIScreenshots.swift` capture helper compiled into both test targets, and a UI test that captures the sample screen in every left-to-right/right-to-left × light/dark cell into `.ui-screenshots/` and runs `performAccessibilityAudit()` at the configured level — watchOS companion-app wiring when `ios` and `watchos` are both selected, `.swiftlint.yml`, `.swift-format`, an optional `fastlane/Fastfile` with lanes gated by `signing`/ `distribution`, and `sonar-project.properties` (omitted when `sonar: none`). The generated `.xcodeproj`/ `.xcworkspace` is never committed. Invoke as `/iru-setup-apple-app`. Accepts pre-resolved inputs via `args` (`key: value` lines) — `app-name`, `bundle-id-prefix`, `platforms` (multi-select: `ios`, `ipados`, `macos`, `watchos`, `visionos` — `ipados` widens the iOS target's `TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY` rather than adding a target; tvOS is not supported), `ui` (`swiftui`/`uikit`, iOS/iPadOS target only, default `swiftui`), `architecture` (`mvvm`/`mvc`; `mvc` only with `uikit`), `generator` (`xcodegen`/`tuist`), `min-deployment-target`, `distribution` (`none`/`internal`/`store`), `signing` (`fastlane-match`/`api-key`/`none`), `license`, `developer-name`, `developer-email`, `organization-url`, `open-source`, `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/ `sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `visibility`, `ci`, `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off`/`none`, default `enforce`), `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`) and `mode` (`new`/`existing`) — so an orchestrating skill can supply them without re-prompting; stand-alone it asks `open-source` first and derives the `sonar` default from it. Announces whether it is scaffolding from scratch or updating; for each owned file that already exists it warns and asks Update / Keep as is / Replace / Stop (unless `on-existing` decides) and never overwrites hand-written source. Versions are looked up at run time with a dated October 2026 fallback table. Equivalent to `iru-setup-android-app`/`iru-setup-react-native-app` for the native Apple stack; use `iru-setup-macos-app` for a macOS-only (SwiftUI or AppKit) desktop app and `iru-setup-swift-library` for a pure SwiftPM library. Use whenever a new native iOS/iPadOS/macOS/watchOS/visionOS application needs its project manifest, testable core, tests, lint/format config and Fastlane/Sonar tooling bootstrapped from this house template.
